2d.gate: the outline rulebook in the app (GET /api/rules), every rule that applies to a drawing, run by outline_draft.py locally and by the app on push. soffit_max_18 is one of its rules.

phases.title: Shell scan (read-only)
phases.brief: OUTLINE_EXPECT_DOC="{doc}" bridge.py script automation/outline_scan.py -> projects/<slug>/outlines/shell.json, with the dashed lines and notes of the D1 simple plan per room (d1_lines). Read-only.

verify.readback: shell.json room count == rooms the contract marks needs_2d; solids_complete true; d1.status ok and every needs_2d room carries d1_lines

phases.title: 2D outlines: {rooms}
phases.brief: Per room: draw every work item listed (tag each drawn element with "work_item": "<id>"; list the items that have no place on a drawing). A room marked shell_changed is drawn on the PROPOSED shape and its geometry.meta says "shell": "proposed". Context lines constrain the layout and are not drawn as work. Dashed lines of the D1 plan: list the room's shapes (outline_draft.py --room <code> --d1-lines); a dashed line is the face or the footprint of casework, NEVER a reason to draw a wall; the layout's "d1_lines" block lists every shape as followed (with the element that follows it), or as not followed with a reason; it goes into geometry.meta.d1_lines. Inspiration pictures: fetch the room's pictures (inspo_fetch.py) and LOOK at each one yourself, beside the details the app read from it. Use a detail where the typed work items and the context leave the layout open; a typed decision ALWAYS wins over a picture. The layout's "inspo" block lists every detail as used, or as not used with a reason; it goes into geometry.meta.inspo. Then outline_draft.py -> local gate -> outline_push.py --from-report --wait-vision.

verify.coverage: every work item drawn or declared not drawable
verify.inspo: every layout detail of the room's pictures listed as used, or as not used with a reason (geometry.meta.inspo)
verify.d1_lines: every dashed shape of the D1 plan in the room listed as followed, or as not followed with a reason (geometry.meta.d1_lines)
